tierReason: graphs/basics-even-spacing.json (scatter then a minimum-spacing prune) and the fill/scatter-even primitive both ship in the installed package and are near-solutions: only the square, the spacing and the candidate count have to change.
title: About 400 markers spread evenly over a square, none closer than 4 m

checks.description: The markers output holds between 340 and 460 instances inclusive (the brief's 'about 400'). Instances that cannot be read on the CPU (device residency) fail every check.

Every marker's instance origin (transform translation) has max(|x|, |z|) <= 50 m and |y| <= 0 m, each with 0.01 m tolerance plus 1e-9 slack; a non-finite coordinate counts as outside or off the ground. Zero markers fails.

The closest pair of marker origins, measured across the ground (XZ), is at least 4 m apart, with 0.001 m tolerance plus 1e-9 slack. Fails with fewer than two markers, with non-finite positions (no finite closest pair), or with more than 50000 markers (not measured).

Cut the square into a 10 x 10 grid of 10 m cells with edges on multiples of 10 m; every cell holds at least one marker origin (markers outside the square's tolerance are ignored; a marker on the far edge counts in the last cell).
